text: {"question":"Under which specific observational selection does the ΛLTB model outperform ΛCDM in resolving the Hubble tension according to the study?","reference_answer":"The ΛLTB model is favored over ΛCDM only when the analysis uses supernovae limited to the redshift interval 0.023 < z < 0.15; including the full supernova sample removes the advantage.","passage_1_contribution":"Abstract states that ΛLTB can explain the Hubble tension and is favored only if…","passage_2_contribution":"Conclusion specifies that the model is favored only when supernovae in 0.023 < z < 0.15 are used, and not when the full sample is considered.","joint_reason":"Both passages refer to the same conditional criterion for model preference, but the concrete redshift range is only provided in the conclusion.","same_quantity":true}
